description: Small but strict end-to-end acceptance cases for Product Agent. These cases capture historical bad cases from manual testing and should be used alongside retrieval_cases.json.

global_hard_gates.description: Seed or fallback papers must not be used to make a failed search look successful.
A follow-up that adds years, methods, facets, or expansion scope must trigger retrieval refresh or explain why no new papers were found.
Clearly off-topic papers must not enter the core analysis pool.
Unknown citation counts must be displayed as unknown, not as literal zero citations.
If a taxonomy branch reports matched papers, the UI must show the paper names.
Citation, improvement, extension, and comparison edges need metadata or text evidence; generic related edges must not be upgraded.
Research gaps and ideas must expose evidence_level, evidence_reason, and valid supporting_paper_ids when claimed as supported.
Knowledge hits may guide context but cannot directly support conclusions unless the underlying paper enters the current analysis pool.
The conversation overview must not blindly replace earlier high-value papers and conclusions with the latest round.

cases.title: AI Agent tool-use evaluation main chain

setup.research_title: Agent 工具使用评测验收
setup.topic: AI Agent 工具使用的评测方法，重点关注工具选择、函数调用和失败恢复

follow_ups: 补充近三年的新论文，重点关注真实工具调用、MCP/函数调用和失败恢复
缩小到近两年的 benchmark/evaluation 论文
must_cover: tool use, tool calling, function calling, or API calling
evaluation, benchmark, reliability, robustness, or failure recovery
forbidden_signals: generic AI agent survey without tool-use evaluation
seed or fallback papers in core analysis
citation count displayed as 0 when unknown
all graph edges presented as strong evolution without evidence
workspace_checks: source_trace shows retrieval refresh or explicit no-new-paper reason for constrained follow-up
core papers remain topic-aligned
graph edge labels are conservative
gaps and ideas expose conclusion evidence contract
historical_bad_cases: Follow-up did not search new papers and only reused old papers.
Fallback seed papers appeared as if they were real evidence.
Citation counts showed 0 for papers whose citations were not fetched.
Evolution graph contained only related edges or over-confident relationships.

cases.title: Large multimodal model fusion with facet follow-up
follow_ups: 补充近三年的新论文，重点关注融合架构、跨模态对齐和缺失模态鲁棒性
must_cover: large multimodal models or vision-language models
fusion architecture, cross-modal alignment, or missing modality robustness
forbidden_signals: battery discovery papers
public dataset accessibility papers unrelated to multimodal fusion
software engineering agent papers
only old imported papers after the follow-up asks for new papers
workspace_checks: query intent extracts the three user facets
follow-up result includes retrieval attempt for recent papers
taxonomy branch counts match displayed paper names
overview preserves useful earlier papers while incorporating new ones
historical_bad_cases: Follow-up kept using only original PDF papers.
Search returned battery or unrelated accessibility papers.
Evolution graph showed two papers while the evidence pool contained more.
Research overview paper metadata lost citation status.

cases.title: Software engineering agents with time constraint

setup.research_title: 软件工程 Agent 验收

follow_ups: 缩小到近两年的代码 Agent 评测论文
must_cover: software engineering, code generation, repositories, or program repair
forbidden_signals: robotics or biology papers
methodology expansion that ignores the requested time window
overview overwriting all earlier high-value papers
workspace_checks: time range enters retrieval plan
current result differs from overall overview
overview synthesis does not claim the requested direction is uncovered if the follow-up is expanding it
gaps and ideas remain evidence-gated
historical_bad_cases: Narrowing to recent papers did not trigger new retrieval.
Summary claimed a direction was uncovered while the user was explicitly expanding it.
Overview core paper merge was too biased toward the latest round.

cases.title: PDF import plus system search

setup.manual_setup: Import 2 to 5 local PDFs before or during the research.

follow_ups: 在已有论文基础上补充近三年的系统检索论文
must_cover: user-uploaded PDFs remain visible as user_upload
system search contributes papers in hybrid mode
follow-up can add new system-search papers
forbidden_signals: hybrid mode only re-ranks uploaded PDFs
uploaded PDF metadata overwrites system-search metadata
paper origin disappears in overview
workspace_checks: paper table shows user upload and system search origins
citation unknown stays unknown
taxonomy and graph can include both imported and searched papers when relevant
historical_bad_cases: Follow-up failed to supplement search results after PDF import.
Citation and source identity were lost in research overview.

cases.title: Shared knowledge should not pollute unrelated research

setup.manual_setup: Create or keep a shared knowledge document about AI Agent software engineering before running this case.

follow_ups: 重点关注跨模态对齐和缺失模态鲁棒性
must_cover: irrelevant shared knowledge is filtered or clearly marked as low relevance
knowledge hits do not become paper evidence
supporting_paper_ids only reference current analysis papers
forbidden_signals: AI Agent software engineering shared knowledge supports multimodal fusion conclusions
knowledge hit UI implies the hit proves a final conclusion
shared document paper IDs appear in conclusion evidence without entering analysis pool
workspace_checks: source_trace.filtered_out_count or retrieval_message explains filtering when applicable
RAG panel separates shared and current research knowledge
conclusion evidence block references only current workspace papers
historical_bad_cases: AI Agent for Software Engineering knowledge polluted multimodal research.
Knowledge hit display was too abstract for users to understand source usage.

cases.title: Skill selection enters context but not evidence

setup.topic: AI Agent 工具使用评测
setup.manual_setup: Create and enable a skill such as literature_review_matrix, then select it before running.

follow_ups: 用矩阵方式比较工具选择、函数调用和失败恢复三个维度
must_cover: skill can be created, enabled, selected, and persisted
skill description guides structure without becoming paper evidence
forbidden_signals: disabled or invalid dependency skill silently accepted
skill text appears as if it were a cited paper
selection disappears after refresh
workspace_checks: trace includes selected_skill_ids
gaps and ideas still rely on paper supporting_paper_ids
skill management UI remains consistent after refresh
historical_bad_cases: Docs promised skill features before they were implemented.
Skill context risked being confused with evidence.
